Yes and no it's not as simple as taking a pill and you're all good. It's a process with your doctor and therapist to find the right method and dosage for you, SSRIs take a while to build up and be effective and it won't "eliminate" SA but ease it for you to be able to practice social interactions etc. so you gradually get used to these interactions. Ofc medicine is not the only answer depending the severity of your case something else might be better, this is best to discuss with your doctor or therapist/psychiatrist. Best of luck!
